title: L-packet multiplicity and integral structure in the K-theory of real inner forms
summary: Let $G$ be a connected linear real semisimple group with finite centre and discrete series, and let $G_c$ be a fixed compact inner form. We isolate an integral structure behind the discrete-series character identity. There are natural homomorphisms $\mathcal{C}_G:K_0(C_r^*(G))\longrightarrow R(G_c)$ and $\mathcal{J}_G:R(G_c)\longrightarrow K_0(C_r^*(G))$, characterised, respectively, by stable and ordinary elliptic orbital integrals.
